title: Crawlers stay out of the /events and /discover/spaces filter combinations

source.ref: SEO, GEO and speed deep scan 2026-11-19 (production crawl of 3,000 URLs, all 720 sitemap pages, 8 crawler user agents, Lighthouse on 14 templates)

detail: A third of a 3,000 URL crawl was filter combinations: 958 /events?... URLs and 68 /discover/spaces?... URLs, each canonical to the plain page. They spend crawl budget that the 720 real pages need before launch. robots now disallows "/events?" and "/discover/spaces?"; the plain pages and every event page stay crawlable.

verify.note: Fails on main: neither query rule is in robots. Passes once both are, and fails again if a rule ever hides the page itself.
